title: UltimateJumpads
description: A lightweight custom made plugin that allows you to create jump pads quickly and easily using a single command. Perfect for servers that want smooth mobility mechanics without complicated setup
body:
![xd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6882fa4e5bc87caeb18e22b8ab4bf1711e03675c_0.webp)


Enhance your server experience with this lightweight and efficient custom plugin that lets you create jump pads instantly using just one command. Easy to use, highly optimized, and perfect for improving player movement and gameplay flow

##  Requirements

Java 21
Paper, Pufferfish or Purpur 1.21+

## Features

Supports JumpPads using pressure plates and slime blocks. Configure where they can be used across worlds regions and more through [Luckperms Contexts](https://luckperms.net/wiki/Context). Includes a simple permission system with **ultrajumppads.admin** for controlling player access. Built with performance in mind using the latest Paper APIs to ensure minimal server impact

## Commands

- /jumppads create (jump radius) (radius of distance)

**Create your custom jump**

- /jumppads reload

**Reload the plugin**
